fixture.description: Synthetic factors and static pose grid; no measured human subject data.
fixture.coordinate_frame: Positions in pelvis anatomical frame: OpenSim x forward, y up, z right. Joint centres are femur/tibia/talus body origins. Positive rotational coordinates have the same names/signs in both models.

sole_fiducials.note: Common synthetic sole landmarks, not source-model contact surfaces; scaled in calcn local axes. OpenSim model has no collision sole geoms. MyoSuite collision support is also recorded separately.

fixture.force_and_torque_definition: Isometric state at activation 1 and zero coordinate speeds. Forces are normalized tendon forces; torque sums the six listed muscles only. OpenSim uses compliant Millard muscle equilibrium with pennation; MuJoCo uses its inextensible-tendon muscle model and analytic fibre coordinate, without pennation.
fixture.mass_mode: volume: ModelScaler preserve_mass_distribution=false, subject mass=-1, MyoSuite mass=volume. keep: preserve_mass_distribution=true, subject mass=-1, MyoSuite mass=keep. No global mass normalization; compare body scaling ratios because nominal model masses differ.

assessment.scope: Fixed synthetic pose grid; nominal equivalence, subject validity and clinical accuracy are not established.
